observations: I read assets/panels/07-4.png. Ravi is outside under a teal awning in morning sun with leaf shadows on the wall, mid-step on the pavement, smiling and waving back toward the door with his raised right hand. His left hand, with the watch, holds the dark-blue phone at his side, which matches production.

Dr. Ananya and Meera wave from the glass doorway at the left. Ananya (white coat, stethoscope, teal kurta, low bun) raises her right hand. Meera (blue kurta, side braid) raises her left hand. Both match production and main-cast at this small scale.

The shoulder bag is on his shoulder as required. Minor continuity drift: here the strap runs over his RIGHT shoulder (the side away from the shirt pocket), while 04-1, 07-1 and 07-2 show it on his LEFT. This page has an off-panel walkthrough between 07-3 and 07-4, the main-cast sheet itself shows the bag on the right shoulder, and production only requires 'on his shoulder'. I judge it a plausible shoulder change that will not confuse readers, so I am not raising it as a blocking issue.
There is no text on the awning, door or street. The background is simple, with trees and a road.

A large flat white rectangle covers the upper left and cuts across the wall and the top of the door frame with a hard edge. The narration caption must cover it at lettering. I am not certifying that here.
Note: an identical copy of this art also sits at assets/panels/06-4.png, but page 6 does not use it.
